formula: range_pct = (high-low)/close; smooth_range = ema(range_pct, span=5); vol_ratio = volume / ts_mean(volume,20); smooth_vol_ratio = if vol_ratio > 0.9 then ema(vol_ratio,10) else ema(vol_ratio,30); direction = (close-open)/close; factor = smooth_range * smooth_vol_ratio * direction
rationale: Crossover of primary (alpha_mutation_gen6_002) and secondary (alpha-mutation-gen6-002). Preserves primary's core directional volume-adjusted volatility mechanism with smooth_range (EWMA span=5) and continuous direction. Borrows the faster EWMA spans (10/30) for the volume ratio from the secondary parent to make the volume regime switching more distinctive, targeting improved IC while maintaining rank-ordering strength.
filter: volume > 0 AND not is_suspend AND close < high_limit AND close > low_limit
